questions.questionHtml: Three positions of a cube are shown below. What will come opposite to face containing ‘5’?
questions.solution:
The four adjacent sides to face containing ‘5’ are ‘3’, ‘6’, ‘4’ and ‘2’. Therefore the opposite side to ‘5’ should be faced containing ‘1’.

Trick:

How to easily find the opposite faces:

Choose any 2 dices which have only one number in common.

As in, I and II only 5 is common.

Now move clockwise as per the dice.

In I, 5 - 3 - 6 

In II, 5 - 2 - 4

So, we can observe that 3 is opposite to 2 and 6 is opposite to 4. 

Now only 5 is left, which will be opposite to 1.

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of Anil and Aakash is 4 : 5. Three years later their ages will be in ratio 7 : 8. What is the present age (in years) of Anil?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of present ages of Anil and Aakash is 4 : 5. Three years later their ages will be in ratio 7 : 8. What is the present age (in years) of Anil?
questions.solution:
Let present ages of Anil and Akash be 4x and 5x.

Their ages 3 years later will be (4x + 3) and (5x + 3) respectively.

Given, (4x + 3) / (5x + 3) = 7 / 8

⇒ 32x + 24 = 35x + 21

⇒ x = 1

Therefore, present ages of Anil is 4 years.

Trick:

According to the question,

        4 : 5

  (+3)↓   ↓(+3)   (This ratio changes by 3 after 3 years)

        7 : 8 

In implies,

3 values = 3 years

so, 1 values = 1 year

So, Anil's age (at present) = 4 × 1 = 4 years

Aakash's age = 5 × 1 = 5 years

Hence, after 3 years, their ages will be 7 and 8 years respectively.

questions.question: Nephron is related to which of the following system of human body?
questions.questionHtml: Nephron is related to which of the following system of human body?
questions.solution:
Concept:

Human Excretory system:

  • The system of the organ which is used to remove the waste product out from the body is called the human excretory system.
  • The major waste product generated in the human body is urea, along with which some other toxins are also generated.
  • Urea is eliminated by kidneys by the process of urination and solid wastes are removed from the body by the intestines.

Excretory system organs:

 

Kidney s:

  • It is a bean shaped organ. Its function is to clean blood and eliminate the waste from the blood in form of urine
  • It is present in the abdomen, just below the diaphragm, and is protected by ribs.
  • Each kidney weighs 120g to 170 g and 10-12 cm long and 5-7 cm wide and is the size of a fist.
  • Kidneys are made up of subunits called Nephron

Ureters: 

  • ​Each kidney is connected to the rinal pelvis by a thin muscular tube, this tube is called as Ureter.
  • Its function is to propel urine from the kidney to the urinary Bladder from time to time.

Bladders:

  • It's the organ that controls the passage of urine, it is a muscular sac-like structure.
  • The average capacity of the bladder is 400-600 ml.
  • It holds urine until its capacity expels, or till it gets full.

Urethra: 

  • The Urethra is a tube made up of fibro muscular tissue that arises from the lower opening of the bladder, and open to the external uretral orifice.
  • It helps to expel urine through the body, in the male it is also the tube that consist of the sperms.

Explanation:

  • In kidneys, the Nephron is the functional unit, each kidney has as many as 1 million nephrons in each human kidney.
  • The basic functions of the nephron are to carry out secretion as well as the process of excretion and also called as filtration unit of the human excretory system.
  • Each nephron is made up of a Malpighian body.
  • Nephrons are of two types which are Cortical Nephrons and Juxtamedullary Nephrons.

  • So, the Nephron is the part that is also called as filtration unit of the Excretory unit.

questions.question: What is the simplified value of (cosA + sinA)(cotA + tanA)?

(cosA + sinA)(cotA + tanA)

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: If 2 cos θ = 2 - sin θ, then what is the value of cos θ?
questions.questionHtml: If 2 cos θ = 2 - sin θ, then what is the value of cos θ?
questions.solution:
Given,

If 2 cosθ = 2 - sinθ

⇒ 2 (cosθ - 1) = -sinθ

Squaring both sides

⇒ 4 (cosθ – 1)2 = sin2θ

⇒ 4 (cosθ – 1)2 = 1 - cos2θ

⇒ 4 cos2θ + 4 - 8 cosθ = 1 - cos2θ

⇒ 5 cos2θ - 8 cosθ + 3 = 0

⇒ 5 cos2θ - 5 cosθ - 3 cosθ + 3 = 0

⇒ 5 cosθ (cosθ – 1) - 3(cosθ – 1) = 0

⇒ (5 cosθ – 3) (cosθ – 1) = 0

⇒ cosθ = 3/5, 1

questions.question: 3 men or 4 women can complete a job in 120 days. 12 men and 16 women will complete the same job in how many days?

Formula used:

W = E × T     Where, W = Work, E = Efficiency, and T = Time

Calculation:

Given: 3 men or 4 women complete a work in 120 days

Time is taken by 12 men to complete the work = (120/12) × 3

⇒ 30 days

Time is taken by 16 women to complete the work = (120/16) × 4

⇒ 30 days

Time is taken by 12 men and 16 women to complete the work = 1/[(1/30) + (1/30)]

Time is taken by 12 men and 16 women to complete the work = 15 days

∴ 12 men and 16 women will complete the same job in 15 days.

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. P: When all the credit worthy people were given loans to a logical limit, they ceased to be a part of the market. Q: Even this would have been understandable if it could work as an eye opener. R: Owing to the materialistic culture elsewhere, it was possible to keep selling newer products to the consumers despite having existing ones which served equally well. S: They were lured through advertising and marketing techniques of 'dustbinisation' of the customer; and then finally, once they became ready customers, they were given loans and credits to help them by more and more.
questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P: When all the credit worthy people were given loans to a logical limit, they ceased to be a part of the market.

Q: Even this would have been understandable if it could work as an eye opener.

R: Owing to the materialistic culture elsewhere, it was possible to keep selling newer products to the consumers despite having existing ones which served equally well.

S: They were lured through advertising and marketing techniques of 'dustbinisation' of the customer; and then finally, once they became ready customers, they were given loans and credits to help them by more and more.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'RSPQ'.
 
Key Points
  • We start with sentence 'R' as it provides an introduction to the materialistic culture and the practice of constantly selling new products, establishing the context.
  • Sentence 'S' then follows this naturally as it details how consumers are drawn in and lured into the system of credits and loans, building upon the information given in 'R'.
  • 'P' is the next logical choice, explaining the consequences of extending credit to the limit and the eventual outcome.
  • 'Q' finally gives a concluding remark about the situation, fitting as an ending to the paragraph.
Therefore, the correct order is 'Option 2'.
 
Additional Information
  • 'PRQS': Here, starting with 'P' does not provide a proper background or setting for the actions described in the subsequent sentences.
  • 'QSPR': Leading with 'Q' is incongruous, as its context relies on understanding the earlier actions and their consequences.
  • 'RPQS': The sequence here almost works, but having 'Q' before 'S' does not match the logical flow of events as 'Q' is more of a concluding remark.

The sentence structure follows the active voice format, making it the correct choice in this context.
  • Option 2 is incorrect because it is still in the passive voice.
